dominant_strengths: Elegant serif title paired with mono microlabels creates editorial contrast that lifts an otherwise standard admin table
Restrained dark palette with muted status pills keeps semantic color readable without overwhelming the dense grid
Consistent vertical rhythm, aligned columns, and tidy avatar monograms show real attention to row-level craft
dominant_weaknesses: Layout is a textbook dark dashboard table — no novel interaction, density mode, or hierarchy beyond conventional sortable columns
'View' buttons are visually weak and repetitive, adding noise to the right edge while the left ID column feels under-utilized
Status and Priority dots use similar saturations, making Critical/High/Active blur at a glance despite different semantics
fix_priorities: Differentiate priority vs status visual language (shape, weight, or position) to reduce semantic collision
Replace per-row 'View' buttons with full-row hover affordance to reclaim horizontal space and reduce repetition
Introduce a distinguishing element — grouped headers, inline sparkline, or density toggle — to escape generic table feel
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral clarity leads, visceral polish is solid but understated, and reflective payoff is limited by familiar patterns.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes — it competently delivers a legible, scannable project tracker table, though without distinguishing ideas beyond the category baseline.
